acceptanceCriteria: The console shows the same warning text after a manual completion that overrides an unmet dependency.
body: V1-0979 (CAL-V0-186) adds a `warnings` entry when complete-manual overrides an unmet COMPLETED-obligation dependency. The optional local admin console (decision 0081) exposes ticket verbs that do not show this warning. Open owner choices recorded by the coordinator: replays do not repeat the warning (claim-warning precedent) and GATE_PASSED dependencies are not warned; revisit only with evidence. Found by the V1-0979 lane, 2026-10-07, base 0b5096ca. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202.
title: admin console: ticket completion verbs do not surface the V1-0979 unsatisfied-dependency warning
